title: Dental PPO Plans Certificate Provision: Waiting Periods
content:
**Waiting periods.** Under the Dental PPO Plans, preventive services have no waiting period. For basic and major services the waiting period depends on the enrollment:
- individual and individual exchange enrollments use the plan's individual basic and major waiting periods;
- group enrollments of a late entrant use the plan's late-entrant basic and major waiting periods;
- group enrollments entered at open enrollment, as new hires or by special enrollment have no waiting period.

**Credit for prior coverage.** *Former clause, no longer in force as written:* "When the plan's prior coverage credit method is month for month, the waiting period is shortened by the prior coverage months (never below zero); with none there is no credit." Current wording: a line reprocessed under the Dental PPO correction rules for waiting-period, new-plan-wait, prior-level and grace-period decisions, a pre-treatment estimate requested under the estimate-request rule, and the payment requested on a second-level claim appeal under the claim-appeal rule each have their months of credit figured as those rules state; every other case remains under this wording: when the plan's prior coverage credit method is month for month the waiting period is shortened by the prior coverage months, never below zero, and with none there is no credit.

**When a service becomes payable (time condition).** A service is payable when its date of service is on or after the coverage effective date plus the remaining waiting months, counted in calendar months, with the last day of the month used when the target day does not exist. A line with an earlier date of service is denied for the waiting period (on an estimate, the estimate carries the waiting-period remark).

**Upgrades.** After an upgrade (a plan change date is set and the new plan is richer for the service), a service whose class is covered under the new plan but was not covered under the prior plan, or whose coinsurance is higher under the new plan, is paid at the new plan's level only once its new waiting period counted from the plan change date (with the same prior-coverage credit) has passed. Before then it is paid at the prior plan's level if the prior plan covered it and its own waiting period had passed, and denied for the waiting period if the prior plan did not cover it. A downgrade carries no new waiting period. Reinstatement without a gap does not restart waiting periods.

### Boundary cases (hypothetical, outside the correction, estimate and appeal rules)
| Coverage effective | Remaining waiting months | Payable from | Date of service | Result |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 February | 6 | 1 August | 1 August | Payable |
| 1 February | 6 | 1 August | 31 July | Denied for the waiting period |
| 1 March, month-for-month plan, 4 documented prior months | 12 less 4, which is 8 | 1 November | 1 November | Payable |

superseded_clauses: When the plan's prior_coverage_credit_method is month_for_month the waiting period is shortened by prior_coverage_months (never below zero); with none there is no credit.
